name: Interval Raymarching
definition: A technique to speed up raymarching with signed distance fields (SDFs) by using affine arithmetic and possibly interval arithmetic to evaluate the SDF over an interval of the ray rather than at a single point.
summary: Interval Raymarching accelerates SDF raymarching by evaluating the field over intervals using affine arithmetic, enabling superlinear convergence and larger steps compared to standard sphere tracing.
